Full API spec:
Namespace: breakout. All public types reside in breakout and are declared in include/*.h and defined in src/*.cpp. Only the C++17 standard library is used. Deterministic, headless, time-stepped logic; no rendering/input/devices/threads/clocks/network.
Types and contracts:
- include/Vector2.h: struct/class Vector2 { double x, y; Vector2(); Vector2(double x, double y); Vector2 operator+(Vector2) const; Vector2 operator-(Vector2) const; Vector2 operator*(double) const; } Semantics: Immutable-returning arithmetic; no side effects.
- include/Playfield.h: class Playfield { public: double width, height; explicit Playfield(double w, double h); double left() const; double right() const; double top() const; double bottom() const; }; Semantics: Returns wall bounds with origin assumed at center or consistent coordinate system used across entities; no mutation after construction except reading dimensions.
- include/Ball.h: class Ball { public: Vector2 position; Vector2 velocity; double radius; Ball(Vector2 p, Vector2 v, double r); void integrate(double dt); }; Semantics: integrate advances position by velocity*dt; deterministic.
- include/Paddle.h: class Paddle { public: Vector2 position; double width; double height; void move(double dx, const Playfield& f); double left() const; double right() const; double top() const; double bottom() const; }; Semantics: move shifts position.x by dx and clamps within Playfield [left,right]. AABB helpers return bounds.
- include/Brick.h: class Brick { public: Vector2 position; double width; double height; int durability; bool isAlive() const; void hit(); double left() const; double right() const; double top() const; double bottom() const; }; Semantics: isAlive() returns durability>0; hit() decrements durability at least to zero.
- include/Level.h: must directly contain #include <cstddef>. class Level { public: std::vector<Brick> bricks; Level(); void generateGrid(int rows, int cols, Vector2 origin, Vector2 cellSize, int hp); std::size_t remaining() const; }; Semantics: generateGrid fills bricks in a grid; remaining() counts bricks with durability>0. Definition of remaining() is in src/Level.cpp and returns std::size_t.
- include/Collision.h: class Collision { public: static bool circleVsAABB(const Ball& b, double left, double right, double top, double bottom); static Vector2 reflect(const Vector2& v, bool flipX, bool flipY); }; Semantics: circle-vs-AABB returns true if ball intersects box; reflect flips velocity components depending on flags.
- include/GameEngine.h: must directly contain #include <cstddef>. class GameEngine { public: enum Input { Left, Right, None }; GameEngine(const Playfield&, const Level&, const Ball&, const Paddle&); void step(double dt, Input input); bool isLevelCleared() const; std::size_t remainingBricks() const; int getScore() const; int getLives() const; }; Semantics: step applies input to paddle (clamped), integrates ball, resolves collisions against walls, paddle, and bricks using breakout::Collision; prevents tunneling via simple pre/post checks; on brick hit, decrements durability and removes/increments score when durability reaches zero; tracks lives on ball loss; level cleared when remaining bricks==0. remainingBricks() returns std::size_t; definition in src/GameEngine.cpp and returns std::size_t.
Implementation constraints:
- src/GameEngine.cpp must directly contain #include "Collision.h" and #include <cmath> and use std::sqrt for any square root.
- Public API includes Level::remaining() and GameEngine::remainingBricks() returning std::size_t; ensure include/Level.h and include/GameEngine.h directly include #include <cstddef>.
Include/test boundaries:
- Tests and callers include only headers from include/*.h; they do not include src/*.cpp; symbols are linked via the core library.
Shared Knowledge: CMakeLists.txt defines a core static library from src/*.cpp excluding src/Main.cpp, a runtime executable from src/Main.cpp, and a test executable from tests/test_main.cpp. Both runtime and test targets link to the core library. Headers are self-contained and include only C++17 standard headers. include/Level.h and include/GameEngine.h directly include <cstddef> and expose std::size_t-returning APIs. src/GameEngine.cpp directly includes "Collision.h" and <cmath> and uses std::sqrt. Core logic is deterministic, headless, and time-stepped. tests/test_main.cpp includes declared headers only and drives the core through public APIs.
Execution Protocol: Build with CMake. Run tests via ctest. There is exactly one protocol-level test file: tests/test_main.cpp. It includes headers only from include/*.h and links against the core library. Runtime entry is src/Main.cpp; it is a thin demonstration and not part of tests. No manual interaction or environment-specific features are required.
